name: Merrowby House Key
description: An iron key to a chalk-cob house in Merrowby, its door painted whatever colour you choose. A Foundling with a door is a Foundling who can be found.

name: Tallow Candle
description: Vale-made tallow. On Candle Night every window in Hearthvale holds one, so the village can be seen being tended.

name: Hemp Rope
description: Twenty paces of Reedfolk hemp. Isseva's boardwalks hang on rope like this and the town is still standing.

name: Reed Lantern
description: A tin lantern with horn panes, Sedgemire pattern. Reedfolk hang these on the burial jetties; it is bad manners to let one go out.

name: Pitch Torch
description: Pitch-wrapped ash. Burns an hour, and in a barrow that is exactly long enough to regret not bringing two.

name: Lockpick
description: A slim iron pick. The Quiet Hands do not sell these, but a Palm will lose a bundle near you if you have been polite.

name: Iron Arrow
description: Ash shaft, iron head, goose fletching from Merrowby's pond. Every Vale fletcher swears the geese know.

name: Crossbow Bolt
description: A short iron bolt, guild-stamped. The Tallymen count them out and count them back.
